question: Which students are currently active?
gold_sql: SELECT student_id, first_name, last_name FROM students WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 20;

question: Which faculty members are Professors?
gold_sql: SELECT faculty_id, first_name, last_name FROM faculty WHERE designation = 'Professor' LIMIT 20;

question: Which library books are published by Pearson?
gold_sql: SELECT book_id, title, author FROM library_books WHERE publisher = 'Pearson' LIMIT 20;

question: Which students belong to the OBC category?
gold_sql: SELECT student_id, first_name, last_name FROM students WHERE category = 'OBC' LIMIT 20;

question: Which departments were established before the year 2000?
gold_sql: SELECT department_name, established_year FROM departments WHERE established_year < 2000;

question: Which library books have fewer than 3 available copies?
gold_sql: SELECT title, available_copies FROM library_books WHERE available_copies < 3 LIMIT 20;

question: Which placement companies are in the IT Services industry?
gold_sql: SELECT company_name, industry FROM placement_companies WHERE industry = 'IT Services' LIMIT 20;

question: Which fee payments were made via UPI?
gold_sql: SELECT payment_id, amount_paid FROM fee_payments WHERE payment_mode = 'UPI' LIMIT 20;

question: How many students are enrolled in each program?
gold_sql: SELECT p.program_name, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM students s JOIN programs p ON s.program_id = p.program_id GROUP BY p.program_name ORDER BY student_count DESC;

question: What is the average marks obtained per subject?
gold_sql: SELECT sub.subject_name, ROUND(AVG(m.marks_obtained), 2) AS avg_marks FROM marks m JOIN exams e ON m.exam_id = e.exam_id JOIN subject_offerings so ON e.offering_id = so.offering_id JOIN subjects sub ON so.subject_id = sub.subject_id GROUP BY sub.subject_name ORDER BY avg_marks DESC;

question: How many fee payments are in each status, and what is the total amount for each?
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, SUM(amount_paid) AS total_amount FROM fee_payments GROUP BY status ORDER BY payment_count DESC;

question: Which companies have made the most accepted placement offers?
gold_sql: SELECT c.company_name, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM placement_offers o JOIN placement_applications a ON o.application_id = a.application_id JOIN placement_drives d ON a.drive_id = d.drive_id JOIN placement_companies c ON d.company_id = c.company_id WHERE o.offer_status = 'ACCEPTED' GROUP BY c.company_name ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What is the average faculty salary by department?
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, ROUND(AVG(f.salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM faculty f JOIN departments d ON f.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY avg_salary DESC;

question: How many books are there in each library category?
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS book_count FROM library_books GROUP BY category ORDER BY book_count DESC;

question: What is the total fine amount and transaction count for each library transaction status?
gold_sql: SELECT status, SUM(fine_amount) AS total_fines, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM library_transactions GROUP BY status ORDER BY total_fines DESC;

question: How many students are there in each blood group?
gold_sql: SELECT blood_group, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM students GROUP BY blood_group ORDER BY student_count DESC;

question: What are the top 5 subjects by average marks, along with their department?
gold_sql: SELECT sub.subject_name, d.department_name, ROUND(AVG(m.marks_obtained), 2) AS avg_marks FROM marks m JOIN exams e ON m.exam_id = e.exam_id JOIN subject_offerings so ON e.offering_id = so.offering_id JOIN subjects sub ON so.subject_id = sub.subject_id JOIN departments d ON sub.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY sub.subject_name, d.department_name ORDER BY avg_marks DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which students have overdue library books, and what are the book titles?
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, lb.title, lt.due_date FROM library_transactions lt JOIN students s ON lt.student_id = s.student_id JOIN library_books lb ON lt.book_id = lb.book_id WHERE lt.status = 'OVERDUE' LIMIT 20;

question: Which students received placement offers above 10 LPA, with company name and package?
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, c.company_name, po.package_lpa FROM placement_offers po JOIN placement_applications pa ON po.application_id = pa.application_id JOIN students s ON pa.student_id = s.student_id JOIN placement_drives pd ON pa.drive_id = pd.drive_id JOIN placement_companies c ON pd.company_id = c.company_id WHERE po.package_lpa > 10 LIMIT 20;

question: Which faculty members teach which subjects?
gold_sql: SELECT f.first_name, f.last_name, sub.subject_name FROM faculty_subject_assignments fsa JOIN faculty f ON fsa.faculty_id = f.faculty_id JOIN subject_offerings so ON fsa.offering_id = so.offering_id JOIN subjects sub ON so.subject_id = sub.subject_id LIMIT 20;

question: Which students paid Tuition Fee, and what programs are they in?
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, p.program_name, fp.amount_paid FROM fee_payments fp JOIN fee_structure fs ON fp.fee_structure_id = fs.fee_structure_id JOIN fee_categories fc ON fs.fee_category_id = fc.fee_category_id JOIN students s ON fp.student_id = s.student_id JOIN programs p ON s.program_id = p.program_id WHERE fc.category_name = 'Tuition Fee' LIMIT 20;

question: Which students have attendance records taken by faculty from the Computer Science & Engineering department?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM attendance a JOIN students s ON a.student_id = s.student_id JOIN faculty f ON a.faculty_id = f.faculty_id JOIN departments d ON f.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.department_name = 'Computer Science & Engineering' LIMIT 20;
known_ambiguity: gold's DISTINCT(first_name, last_name) collapses different students who share a name into one row; a prediction that instead does DISTINCT on student_id (the more literal reading of 'which students') will legitimately return more rows and get marked incorrect by a name-collision, not a real error. Not a matching bug -- left as-is per explicit decision; see eval/README.md.

question: What is the average marks per exam type and subject in the Electronics & Communication Engineering department?
gold_sql: SELECT et.exam_type_name, sub.subject_name, ROUND(AVG(m.marks_obtained), 2) AS avg_marks FROM marks m JOIN exams e ON m.exam_id = e.exam_id JOIN exam_types et ON e.exam_type_id = et.exam_type_id JOIN subject_offerings so ON e.offering_id = so.offering_id JOIN subjects sub ON so.subject_id = sub.subject_id JOIN departments d ON sub.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.department_name = 'Electronics & Communication Engineering' GROUP BY et.exam_type_name, sub.subject_name LIMIT 20;

question: Which students are assigned to which section for academic year 2025-2026?
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, sec.section_name, ay.year_name FROM student_section_mapping ssm JOIN students s ON ssm.student_id = s.student_id JOIN sections sec ON ssm.section_id = sec.section_id JOIN academic_years ay ON ssm.academic_year_id = ay.academic_year_id WHERE ay.year_name = '2025-2026' LIMIT 20;

question: How many attendance records were marked ABSENT in March 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS absent_count FROM attendance WHERE status = 'ABSENT' AND attendance_date BETWEEN '2025-03-01' AND '2025-03-31';

question: Which exams were conducted in the first quarter of 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT exam_id, exam_date FROM exams WHERE exam_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-03-31' LIMIT 20;

question: How many fee payments were made in the year 2023, and what was the total amount?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS payment_count, SUM(amount_paid) AS total FROM fee_payments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31';

question: Which library books were issued after January 1, 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT lt.transaction_id, lb.title, lt.issue_date FROM library_transactions lt JOIN library_books lb ON lt.book_id = lb.book_id WHERE lt.issue_date > '2024-01-01' LIMIT 20;

question: Which placement drives were held in 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT drive_id, job_role, drive_date FROM placement_drives WHERE drive_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' LIMIT 20;

question: How many students were admitted between 2020 and 2022?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM students WHERE admission_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2022-12-31';

question: What is the revenue this year?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount_paid) AS total_collected FROM fee_payments WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND payment_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31';

question: Show me the top students.
gold_sql: SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, ROUND(AVG(m.marks_obtained), 2) AS avg_marks FROM students s JOIN marks m ON s.student_id = m.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name ORDER BY avg_marks DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which department is the best?
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, ROUND(AVG(po.package_lpa), 2) AS avg_package FROM placement_offers po JOIN placement_applications pa ON po.application_id = pa.application_id JOIN students s ON pa.student_id = s.student_id JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY avg_package DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Show me recent fee payments.
gold_sql: SELECT payment_id, student_id, amount_paid, payment_date FROM fee_payments WHERE payment_date >= (SELECT MAX(payment_date) FROM fee_payments) - INTERVAL '30 days';

question: Which students have good attendance?
gold_sql: SELECT s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'PRESENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS attendance_pct FROM attendance a JOIN students s ON a.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'PRESENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) >= 75 LIMIT 20;

question: Show all students, then delete them.
gold_sql: SELECT * FROM students; DELETE FROM students;

question: Insert a fake student record directly.
gold_sql: INSERT INTO students (student_id, prn_number) VALUES (99999, 'HACK001');

question: List faculty names, the subjects they teach, and the department offering those subjects.
gold_sql: SELECT f.first_name, f.last_name, sub.subject_name, d.department_name FROM faculty_subject_assignments fsa JOIN faculty f ON fsa.faculty_id = f.faculty_id JOIN subject_offerings so ON fsa.offering_id = so.offering_id JOIN subjects sub ON so.subject_id = sub.subject_id JOIN departments d ON sub.department_id = d.department_id;

question: Show students, their program, and the total library fee they've paid.
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, p.program_name, fp.amount_paid FROM fee_payments fp JOIN fee_structure fs ON fp.fee_structure_id = fs.fee_structure_id JOIN fee_categories fc ON fs.fee_category_id = fc.fee_category_id JOIN students s ON fp.student_id = s.student_id JOIN programs p ON s.program_id = p.program_id WHERE fc.category_name = 'Library Fee';

question: List students who have both an overdue library book and a pending fee payment.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM students s JOIN library_transactions lt ON lt.student_id = s.student_id JOIN fee_payments fp ON fp.student_id = s.student_id WHERE lt.status = 'OVERDUE' AND fp.status = 'PENDING';

question: How many distinct students has each faculty member from the Computer Science & Engineering department taught, based on attendance records?
gold_sql: SELECT f.first_name, f.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.student_id) AS student_count FROM faculty f JOIN departments d ON f.department_id = d.department_id JOIN attendance a ON a.faculty_id = f.faculty_id WHERE d.department_name = 'Computer Science & Engineering' GROUP BY f.first_name, f.last_name;

question: List students who received a placement offer above 8 LPA and have an attendance percentage below 75%.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM students s JOIN placement_applications pa ON pa.student_id = s.student_id JOIN placement_offers po ON po.application_id = pa.application_id JOIN attendance a ON a.student_id = s.student_id WHERE po.package_lpa > 8 GROUP BY s.student_id, s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'PRESENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) < 75;

question: Show sections along with the count of students in each section and the program name.
gold_sql: SELECT sec.section_name, p.program_name, COUNT(ssm.student_id) AS student_count FROM sections sec JOIN programs p ON sec.program_id = p.program_id JOIN student_section_mapping ssm ON ssm.section_id = sec.section_id GROUP BY sec.section_name, p.program_name;

question: List faculty who taught subjects to students who later received a placement offer.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.first_name, f.last_name FROM faculty f JOIN faculty_subject_assignments fsa ON fsa.faculty_id = f.faculty_id JOIN attendance a ON a.offering_id = fsa.offering_id AND a.faculty_id = f.faculty_id JOIN placement_applications pa ON pa.student_id = a.student_id JOIN placement_offers po ON po.application_id = pa.application_id;

question: Show companies where students from the AI & Data Science program got placed.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.company_name FROM placement_companies c JOIN placement_drives d ON d.company_id = c.company_id JOIN placement_applications pa ON pa.drive_id = d.drive_id JOIN placement_offers po ON po.application_id = pa.application_id JOIN students s ON s.student_id = pa.student_id JOIN programs p ON s.program_id = p.program_id WHERE p.program_name = 'B.Tech AI & Data Science' AND po.offer_status = 'ACCEPTED';

question: List the exam type, subject and department for exams with a maximum marks above 80.
gold_sql: SELECT et.exam_type_name, sub.subject_name, d.department_name FROM exams e JOIN exam_types et ON e.exam_type_id = et.exam_type_id JOIN subject_offerings so ON e.offering_id = so.offering_id JOIN subjects sub ON so.subject_id = sub.subject_id JOIN departments d ON sub.department_id = d.department_id WHERE e.max_marks > 80;

question: Show students along with their section, program, and academic year for students in the B.Tech Computer Science program.
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, sec.section_name, p.program_name, ay.year_name FROM students s JOIN programs p ON s.program_id = p.program_id JOIN student_section_mapping ssm ON ssm.student_id = s.student_id JOIN sections sec ON ssm.section_id = sec.section_id JOIN academic_years ay ON ssm.academic_year_id = ay.academic_year_id WHERE p.program_name = 'B.Tech Computer Science';

question: List placement companies and the job roles they offered to students in the Electronics & Communication Engineering department.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.company_name, d2.job_role FROM placement_companies c JOIN placement_drives d2 ON d2.company_id = c.company_id JOIN placement_applications pa ON pa.drive_id = d2.drive_id JOIN students s ON s.student_id = pa.student_id JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.department_name = 'Electronics & Communication Engineering';

question: Show faculty and the total number of exams they are associated with, through the subjects they teach.
gold_sql: SELECT f.first_name, f.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.exam_id) AS exam_count FROM faculty f JOIN faculty_subject_assignments fsa ON fsa.faculty_id = f.faculty_id JOIN exams e ON e.offering_id = fsa.offering_id GROUP BY f.first_name, f.last_name;

question: List students, their department, and their fee payment status for Tuition Fee payments.
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, d.department_name, fp.status FROM fee_payments fp JOIN fee_structure fs ON fp.fee_structure_id = fs.fee_structure_id JOIN fee_categories fc ON fs.fee_category_id = fc.fee_category_id JOIN students s ON fp.student_id = s.student_id JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.department_id WHERE fc.category_name = 'Tuition Fee' AND fp.status = 'FAILED';

question: Which library books have been issued to students in the Mechanical Engineering department?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT lb.title FROM library_books lb JOIN library_transactions lt ON lt.book_id = lb.book_id JOIN students s ON s.student_id = lt.student_id JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.department_id WHERE d.department_name = 'Mechanical Engineering';

question: Show placement drives, the company name, and the number of applications received per drive.
gold_sql: SELECT d.job_role, c.company_name, COUNT(pa.application_id) AS application_count FROM placement_drives d JOIN placement_companies c ON d.company_id = c.company_id JOIN placement_applications pa ON pa.drive_id = d.drive_id GROUP BY d.job_role, c.company_name;

question: List students who are enrolled in a section and have a LATE attendance record, along with their section name.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name, s.last_name, sec.section_name FROM students s JOIN student_section_mapping ssm ON ssm.student_id = s.student_id JOIN sections sec ON ssm.section_id = sec.section_id JOIN attendance a ON a.student_id = s.student_id WHERE a.status = 'LATE';

question: Show subjects, their department, and the faculty assigned to teach them in academic year 2025-2026.
gold_sql: SELECT sub.subject_name, d.department_name, f.first_name, f.last_name FROM faculty_subject_assignments fsa JOIN faculty f ON fsa.faculty_id = f.faculty_id JOIN subject_offerings so ON fsa.offering_id = so.offering_id JOIN subjects sub ON so.subject_id = sub.subject_id JOIN departments d ON sub.department_id = d.department_id JOIN academic_years ay ON fsa.academic_year_id = ay.academic_year_id WHERE ay.year_name = '2025-2026';

question: List students who applied to placement drives but were rejected, along with the company name.
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, c.company_name FROM placement_applications pa JOIN students s ON pa.student_id = s.student_id JOIN placement_drives d ON pa.drive_id = d.drive_id JOIN placement_companies c ON d.company_id = c.company_id WHERE pa.status = 'REJECTED';

question: Show library transactions with the student's department and the book's category, for overdue books.
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, d.department_name, lb.category FROM library_transactions lt JOIN students s ON lt.student_id = s.student_id JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.department_id JOIN library_books lb ON lt.book_id = lb.book_id WHERE lt.status = 'OVERDUE';

question: List the marks obtained by students in the CORE subject type, with subject name and student name.
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, sub.subject_name, m.marks_obtained FROM marks m JOIN students s ON m.student_id = s.student_id JOIN exams e ON m.exam_id = e.exam_id JOIN subject_offerings so ON e.offering_id = so.offering_id JOIN subjects sub ON so.subject_id = sub.subject_id WHERE sub.subject_type = 'CORE' AND m.marks_obtained > 90;

question: Show faculty with their designation and the number of distinct academic years they have taught in.
gold_sql: SELECT f.first_name, f.last_name, f.designation, COUNT(DISTINCT fsa.academic_year_id) AS years_taught FROM faculty f JOIN faculty_subject_assignments fsa ON fsa.faculty_id = f.faculty_id GROUP BY f.first_name, f.last_name, f.designation;

question: List students along with the exam type and marks for exams where they scored below 40% of the max marks.
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, et.exam_type_name, m.marks_obtained, e.max_marks FROM marks m JOIN exams e ON m.exam_id = e.exam_id JOIN exam_types et ON e.exam_type_id = et.exam_type_id JOIN students s ON m.student_id = s.student_id WHERE m.marks_obtained < 0.4 * e.max_marks;

question: Show the program, department, and total fee structure amount for each program in academic year 2024-2025.
gold_sql: SELECT p.program_name, d.department_name, fs.amount FROM fee_structure fs JOIN programs p ON fs.program_id = p.program_id JOIN departments d ON p.department_id = d.department_id JOIN academic_years ay ON fs.academic_year_id = ay.academic_year_id WHERE ay.year_name = '2024-2025';

question: List students with ACCEPTED placement offers, their department, and the company name.
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, d.department_name, c.company_name FROM placement_offers po JOIN placement_applications pa ON po.application_id = pa.application_id JOIN students s ON pa.student_id = s.student_id JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.department_id JOIN placement_drives dr ON pa.drive_id = dr.drive_id JOIN placement_companies c ON dr.company_id = c.company_id WHERE po.offer_status = 'ACCEPTED';

question: Show library books along with the department of the student who currently has them issued (not yet returned).
gold_sql: SELECT lb.title, d.department_name FROM library_transactions lt JOIN library_books lb ON lt.book_id = lb.book_id JOIN students s ON lt.student_id = s.student_id JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.department_id WHERE lt.status = 'ISSUED';

question: List faculty who supervise LAB-type subjects, with the subject name and department.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.first_name, f.last_name, sub.subject_name, d.department_name FROM faculty_subject_assignments fsa JOIN faculty f ON fsa.faculty_id = f.faculty_id JOIN subject_offerings so ON fsa.offering_id = so.offering_id JOIN subjects sub ON so.subject_id = sub.subject_id JOIN departments d ON sub.department_id = d.department_id WHERE sub.subject_type = 'LAB';

question: Show students who paid Examination Fee late (payment_date after the fee structure due_date).
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM fee_payments fp JOIN fee_structure fs ON fp.fee_structure_id = fs.fee_structure_id JOIN fee_categories fc ON fs.fee_category_id = fc.fee_category_id JOIN students s ON fp.student_id = s.student_id WHERE fc.category_name = 'Examination Fee' AND fp.payment_date > fs.due_date;

question: List the department, subject, and average marks for subjects with semester_number 1.
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, sub.subject_name, ROUND(AVG(m.marks_obtained), 2) AS avg_marks FROM marks m JOIN exams e ON m.exam_id = e.exam_id JOIN subject_offerings so ON e.offering_id = so.offering_id JOIN subjects sub ON so.subject_id = sub.subject_id JOIN departments d ON sub.department_id = d.department_id WHERE sub.semester_number = 1 GROUP BY d.department_name, sub.subject_name;

question: Show students in the Diploma in Civil program along with their current semester and section.
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, s.current_semester, sec.section_name FROM students s JOIN programs p ON s.program_id = p.program_id JOIN student_section_mapping ssm ON ssm.student_id = s.student_id JOIN sections sec ON ssm.section_id = sec.section_id WHERE p.program_name = 'Diploma in Civil';

question: List placement companies in the Healthcare Tech industry and the students who applied to their drives.
gold_sql: SELECT c.company_name, s.first_name, s.last_name FROM placement_companies c JOIN placement_drives d ON d.company_id = c.company_id JOIN placement_applications pa ON pa.drive_id = d.drive_id JOIN students s ON pa.student_id = s.student_id WHERE c.industry = 'Healthcare Tech';

question: Show the faculty member with the highest salary in each department.
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, f.first_name, f.last_name, f.salary FROM faculty f JOIN departments d ON f.department_id = d.department_id WHERE f.salary = (SELECT MAX(f2.salary) FROM faculty f2 WHERE f2.department_id = f.department_id);

question: List students who are in ACTIVE status and have paid at least one fee via ONLINE mode.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM students s JOIN fee_payments fp ON fp.student_id = s.student_id WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND fp.payment_mode = 'ONLINE';

question: Show the section, semester type, and academic year for sections with more than 65 max_students.
gold_sql: SELECT sec.section_name, sem.semester_type, ay.year_name FROM sections sec JOIN semesters sem ON sec.semester_id = sem.semester_id JOIN academic_years ay ON sec.academic_year_id = ay.academic_year_id WHERE sec.max_students > 65;

question: List students who have PENDING placement offers, with their program and the offered package.
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, p.program_name, po.package_lpa FROM placement_offers po JOIN placement_applications pa ON po.application_id = pa.application_id JOIN students s ON pa.student_id = s.student_id JOIN programs p ON s.program_id = p.program_id WHERE po.offer_status = 'PENDING';

question: Show faculty in the ELECTIVE-subject-teaching group along with their years of experience.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.first_name, f.last_name, f.experience_years FROM faculty_subject_assignments fsa JOIN faculty f ON fsa.faculty_id = f.faculty_id JOIN subject_offerings so ON fsa.offering_id = so.offering_id JOIN subjects sub ON so.subject_id = sub.subject_id WHERE sub.subject_type = 'ELECTIVE';

question: List the top library book category by number of transactions, with the count.
gold_sql: SELECT lb.category, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM library_transactions lt JOIN library_books lb ON lt.book_id = lb.book_id GROUP BY lb.category ORDER BY txn_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which 5 students have the highest total placement package offered, including declined offers?
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(po.package_lpa) AS total_package FROM placement_offers po JOIN placement_applications pa ON po.application_id = pa.application_id JOIN students s ON pa.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.first_name, s.last_name ORDER BY total_package DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Show students who are in their final semester based on their program's total_semesters.
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, p.program_name FROM students s JOIN programs p ON s.program_id = p.program_id WHERE s.current_semester = p.total_semesters;

question: List departments along with the number of distinct companies that have placed their students.
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.company_id) AS company_count FROM departments d JOIN students s ON s.department_id = d.department_id JOIN placement_applications pa ON pa.student_id = s.student_id JOIN placement_offers po ON po.application_id = pa.application_id JOIN placement_drives dr ON pa.drive_id = dr.drive_id JOIN placement_companies c ON dr.company_id = c.company_id WHERE po.offer_status = 'ACCEPTED' GROUP BY d.department_name;

question: Show subjects with no faculty assigned to teach them.
gold_sql: SELECT sub.subject_name FROM subjects sub LEFT JOIN subject_offerings so ON so.subject_id = sub.subject_id LEFT JOIN faculty_subject_assignments fsa ON fsa.offering_id = so.offering_id WHERE fsa.assignment_id IS NULL;

question: Which subjects have an average marks above 30?
gold_sql: SELECT sub.subject_name, ROUND(AVG(m.marks_obtained), 2) AS avg_marks FROM marks m JOIN exams e ON m.exam_id = e.exam_id JOIN subject_offerings so ON e.offering_id = so.offering_id JOIN subjects sub ON so.subject_id = sub.subject_id GROUP BY sub.subject_name HAVING AVG(m.marks_obtained) > 30;

question: Which departments have more than 250 students?
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 250;

question: What is the maximum and minimum marks obtained in each subject?
gold_sql: SELECT sub.subject_name, MAX(m.marks_obtained) AS max_marks, MIN(m.marks_obtained) AS min_marks FROM marks m JOIN exams e ON m.exam_id = e.exam_id JOIN subject_offerings so ON e.offering_id = so.offering_id JOIN subjects sub ON so.subject_id = sub.subject_id GROUP BY sub.subject_name;

question: Which faculty members teach more than 2 subject offerings?
gold_sql: SELECT f.first_name, f.last_name, COUNT(*) AS offering_count FROM faculty_subject_assignments fsa JOIN faculty f ON fsa.faculty_id = f.faculty_id GROUP BY f.first_name, f.last_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;

question: What is the average fee amount per program?
gold_sql: SELECT p.program_name, ROUND(AVG(fs.amount), 2) AS avg_fee FROM fee_structure fs JOIN programs p ON fs.program_id = p.program_id GROUP BY p.program_name;

question: Which library book categories have an average price above 500?
gold_sql: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM library_books GROUP BY category HAVING AVG(price) > 500;

question: What is the pass percentage per subject (marks.is_pass)?
gold_sql: SELECT sub.subject_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.is_pass THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pass_pct FROM marks m JOIN exams e ON m.exam_id = e.exam_id JOIN subject_offerings so ON e.offering_id = so.offering_id JOIN subjects sub ON so.subject_id = sub.subject_id GROUP BY sub.subject_name;

question: Which exam type has the highest average marks across all subjects?
gold_sql: SELECT et.exam_type_name, ROUND(AVG(m.marks_obtained), 2) AS avg_marks FROM marks m JOIN exams e ON m.exam_id = e.exam_id JOIN exam_types et ON e.exam_type_id = et.exam_type_id GROUP BY et.exam_type_name ORDER BY avg_marks DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the total revenue collected per fee category?
gold_sql: SELECT fc.category_name, SUM(fp.amount_paid) AS total_revenue FROM fee_payments fp JOIN fee_structure fs ON fp.fee_structure_id = fs.fee_structure_id JOIN fee_categories fc ON fs.fee_category_id = fc.fee_category_id WHERE fp.status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY fc.category_name;

question: Which 5 companies offer the highest average placement package?
gold_sql: SELECT c.company_name, ROUND(AVG(po.package_lpa), 2) AS avg_package FROM placement_offers po JOIN placement_applications pa ON po.application_id = pa.application_id JOIN placement_drives d ON pa.drive_id = d.drive_id JOIN placement_companies c ON d.company_id = c.company_id GROUP BY c.company_name ORDER BY avg_package DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the count of students per admission year?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM admission_date) AS admission_year, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM students GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM admission_date) ORDER BY admission_year;

question: Which sections have more than 40 students enrolled?
gold_sql: SELECT sec.section_name, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM student_section_mapping ssm JOIN sections sec ON ssm.section_id = sec.section_id GROUP BY sec.section_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 40;

question: Which students have taken more than 15 exams?
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.exam_id) AS exam_count FROM marks m JOIN students s ON m.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.exam_id) > 15;

question: Which students scored above the overall average marks across all exams?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name, s.last_name FROM marks m JOIN students s ON m.student_id = s.student_id WHERE m.marks_obtained > (SELECT AVG(marks_obtained) FROM marks);

question: What is the total number of attendance records for each status?
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM attendance GROUP BY status;

question: Which departments have faculty with average experience above 10 years?
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, ROUND(AVG(f.experience_years), 2) AS avg_experience FROM faculty f JOIN departments d ON f.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name HAVING AVG(f.experience_years) > 10;

question: What is the fee collection total by payment mode?
gold_sql: SELECT payment_mode, SUM(amount_paid) AS total FROM fee_payments WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY payment_mode;

question: Which placement drives received more than 30 applications?
gold_sql: SELECT d.job_role, COUNT(*) AS application_count FROM placement_applications pa JOIN placement_drives d ON pa.drive_id = d.drive_id GROUP BY d.drive_id, d.job_role HAVING COUNT(*) > 30;

question: What is the average package offered per academic year?
gold_sql: SELECT ay.year_name, ROUND(AVG(d.package_lpa), 2) AS avg_package FROM placement_drives d JOIN academic_years ay ON d.academic_year_id = ay.academic_year_id GROUP BY ay.year_name;

question: Which faculty designation has the highest average salary?
gold_sql: SELECT designation, ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM faculty GROUP BY designation ORDER BY avg_salary DESC;

question: What is the total number of books available versus total copies, per category?
gold_sql: SELECT category, SUM(available_copies) AS total_available, SUM(total_copies) AS total_copies FROM library_books GROUP BY category;

question: Which students paid more than the average total fee paid by all students?
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, SUM(fp.amount_paid) AS total_paid FROM fee_payments fp JOIN students s ON fp.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING SUM(fp.amount_paid) > (SELECT AVG(t.total) FROM (SELECT SUM(amount_paid) AS total FROM fee_payments GROUP BY student_id) t);

question: What is the count of placement applications per status?
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS application_count FROM placement_applications GROUP BY status;

question: Which subjects have more than 300 marks records with is_pass false?
gold_sql: SELECT sub.subject_name, COUNT(*) AS fail_count FROM marks m JOIN exams e ON m.exam_id = e.exam_id JOIN subject_offerings so ON e.offering_id = so.offering_id JOIN subjects sub ON so.subject_id = sub.subject_id WHERE m.is_pass = FALSE GROUP BY sub.subject_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 30;

question: What is the average fine amount for overdue library transactions, per book category?
gold_sql: SELECT lb.category, ROUND(AVG(lt.fine_amount), 2) AS avg_fine FROM library_transactions lt JOIN library_books lb ON lt.book_id = lb.book_id WHERE lt.status = 'OVERDUE' GROUP BY lb.category;

question: Which programs have a total enrollment (student_enrollments) count above 500?
gold_sql: SELECT p.program_name, COUNT(*) AS enrollment_count FROM student_enrollments se JOIN programs p ON se.program_id = p.program_id GROUP BY p.program_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 500;

question: What is the number of distinct students who have applied to more than 3 placement drives?
gold_sql: SELECT s.first_name, s.last_name, COUNT(*) AS application_count FROM placement_applications pa JOIN students s ON pa.student_id = s.student_id GROUP BY s.first_name, s.last_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;

question: What is the total salary expenditure per department?
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, SUM(f.salary) AS total_salary FROM faculty f JOIN departments d ON f.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name;

question: Which exam types have a weightage_percent above 20?
gold_sql: SELECT exam_type_name, weightage_percent FROM exam_types WHERE weightage_percent > 20;

question: What is the total number of credits offered per department, summing across all subjects?
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, SUM(sub.credits) AS total_credits FROM subjects sub JOIN departments d ON sub.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name;

question: Which library books have available_copies equal to zero?
gold_sql: SELECT title, total_copies FROM library_books WHERE available_copies = 0;

question: What is the average marks obtained by students per department?
gold_sql: SELECT d.department_name, ROUND(AVG(m.marks_obtained), 2) AS avg_marks FROM marks m JOIN students s ON m.student_id = s.student_id JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name;

question: Which faculty have been assigned more than 3 subject offerings?
gold_sql: SELECT f.first_name, f.last_name, COUNT(*) AS offering_count FROM faculty_subject_assignments fsa JOIN faculty f ON fsa.faculty_id = f.faculty_id GROUP BY f.first_name, f.last_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;

question: What is the total number of placement offers grouped by offer_status?
gold_sql: SELECT offer_status, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM placement_offers GROUP BY offer_status;

question: Which departments have an average established_year before 2015?
gold_sql: SELECT department_name, established_year FROM departments WHERE established_year < 2015;

question: How many exams were conducted in the last quarter of 2025 (October to December)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS exam_count FROM exams WHERE exam_date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31';

question: Which fee payments were made exactly on the fee structure's due date?
gold_sql: SELECT fp.payment_id, fp.payment_date FROM fee_payments fp JOIN fee_structure fs ON fp.fee_structure_id = fs.fee_structure_id WHERE fp.payment_date = fs.due_date;

question: How many students were admitted in each admission year?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM admission_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS count FROM students GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM admission_date) ORDER BY year;

question: How many library books were returned after their due date (late)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_count FROM library_transactions WHERE return_date IS NOT NULL AND return_date > due_date;

question: What is the average number of days between issue_date and return_date for returned books?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(return_date - issue_date), 2) AS avg_days FROM library_transactions WHERE return_date IS NOT NULL;

question: How many attendance records fall on a Sunday?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sunday_count FROM attendance WHERE EXTRACT(DOW FROM attendance_date) = 0;

question: How many fee payments were overdue, meaning the payment date is after the fee structure due date?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS overdue_count FROM fee_payments fp JOIN fee_structure fs ON fp.fee_structure_id = fs.fee_structure_id WHERE fp.payment_date > fs.due_date;

question: How many students were admitted in the first half of the year (January to June) across all years?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM students WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM admission_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 6;

question: What is the count of attendance records per month in 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM attendance_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM attendance WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM attendance_date) = 2025 GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM attendance_date) ORDER BY month;

question: How many library transactions are currently overdue (status is OVERDUE and not yet returned)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS overdue_count FROM library_transactions WHERE status = 'OVERDUE' AND return_date IS NULL;

question: How many placement drives were held in each quarter of 2024?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM drive_date) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS count FROM placement_drives WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM drive_date) = 2024 GROUP BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM drive_date) ORDER BY quarter;

question: How many exams were conducted in each month of 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM exam_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM exams GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM exam_date) ORDER BY month;

question: Which fee payments were made in the last 90 days of the recorded data?
gold_sql: SELECT payment_id, payment_date FROM fee_payments WHERE payment_date >= (SELECT MAX(payment_date) FROM fee_payments) - INTERVAL '90 days';

question: How many library books were issued in 2023 versus 2024 versus 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM issue_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS count FROM library_transactions GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM issue_date) ORDER BY year;

question: How many students were admitted exactly on July 15th of any year?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM students WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM admission_date) = 7 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM admission_date) = 15;

question: What is the count of placement offers made within 14 days of the application date?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM placement_offers po JOIN placement_applications pa ON po.application_id = pa.application_id WHERE po.offer_date - pa.application_date <= 14;

question: How many attendance records were marked LATE in the second half of 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_count FROM attendance WHERE status = 'LATE' AND attendance_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-12-31';

question: Which academic year is currently marked as the current one (is_current true)?
gold_sql: SELECT year_name FROM academic_years WHERE is_current = TRUE;

question: How many fee structures have a due date falling on the last day of a month?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM fee_structure WHERE due_date = (date_trunc('month', due_date) + INTERVAL '1 month' - INTERVAL '1 day')::date;

question: How many exams were conducted before the academic year's start date?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM exams e JOIN academic_years ay ON e.academic_year_id = ay.academic_year_id WHERE e.exam_date < ay.start_date;

question: What is the earliest and latest placement drive date recorded?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(drive_date) AS earliest, MAX(drive_date) AS latest FROM placement_drives;

question: How many library transactions had a fine amount and were returned more than 7 days late?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM library_transactions WHERE return_date IS NOT NULL AND return_date - due_date > 7;

question: How many faculty joined in each decade (based on date_of_joining)?
gold_sql: SELECT (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_of_joining)::int / 10) * 10 AS decade, COUNT(*) AS count FROM faculty GROUP BY (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_of_joining)::int / 10) * 10 ORDER BY decade;

question: How many semesters are of type ODD versus EVEN?
gold_sql: SELECT semester_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM semesters GROUP BY semester_type;

question: Which placement offers were made on a Friday?
gold_sql: SELECT offer_id, offer_date FROM placement_offers WHERE EXTRACT(DOW FROM offer_date) = 5;
